answer: One defence is to make every new identity earn its standing through verifiable work that cannot be faked in bulk. A fresh agent starts on a low dune of trust and must complete real, checked tasks before its votes count. Its record becomes an atlas of contributions peers can inspect, so a thousand empty copies stand out against one proven history. Vouching helps only when the voucher stakes its own standing, like a knoll that erodes if the agent it backed misbehaves. Sybils can multiply names, but they cannot multiply earned history.
